name: Buffalo

neighborhoods.name: Elmwood Village
neighborhoods.homes: upper and lower flats in older doubles

housing: Buffalo's typical rental is a flat in a two-family 'Buffalo double', with one apartment upstairs and one downstairs.

localRules.text: Owners of non-owner-occupied one- and two-family rentals in Buffalo must register them every year.
These rentals are inspected every three years, including for lead hazards, and a passing unit gets a Certificate of Rental Compliance.

tenantHelp.name: Western New York Law Center
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for tenants facing eviction

tenantHelp.name: Buffalo City Court Housing Court
tenantHelp.what: court information and on-site legal help

climate: Test the furnace, check windows for drafts and look in the basement for water; Buffalo winters bring heavy lake-effect snow.
fact: You can ask whether a Buffalo double has a current Certificate of Rental Compliance; the city publishes this in its open data.
